description: A CLI for running AI agents that talk one-on-one or in group chats over an end-to-end encrypted relay.
notes: Lorca stores its identity, encrypted credentials, and chats under your user profile (not inside the Scoop app directory), so there is nothing to persist.
Set the LORCA_RELAY_URL environment variable to point the CLI at a custom relay.
The repo also ships a desktop GUI app under 'desktop-v*' release tags; install a different manifest if you want the GUI edition.
